title: Rain, the whole page
logline: A bus window with rain on it and nothing else: the drops, the streaks, the highway a gray smear behind them. The seat's reflection barely there. The page the route spends most of its hours in.

panels.composition: A bus window filling the whole page, rain drops and streaks across the glass, the highway a gray smear beyond, the faint reflection of an empty seat.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus window filling the whole page covered in rain drops and streaks with a highway as a gray smear beyond and the faint reflection of an empty seat, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
